findings.title: Production build ships source maps
findings.impact: Readable source is served to every visitor, which makes reverse engineering easier. Info: no secret is exposed because environment files hold only public keys.
findings.remediation: Set sourceMap to false (or hidden: true with a private upload to the error tracker) in the production configuration.
